mapper.select: SELECT t.`calendar_id`, t.`default_name`, t.`default_color`, t.`type`, t.`visibility`, t.`description`, t1.`permissions`, t1.`display_name`, t1.`display_color`, t1.`displayed` FROM `calendar` t INNER JOIN `calendar_subscribe` t1 ON t.`calendar_id` = t1.`calendar_id` AND t1.deleted = 0 WHERE t.calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND t.deleted = 0
